name: Calendar page, day circled
description: A white tear-off calendar page with metal rings and an orange month header swings down into the top band over the speaker: a huge day number and the weekday in orange; the weekday gets circled in black marker with a white hand-written note beside it ('limits reset!'), and optionally the page is torn off at the end, tilting and falling away.
use_when: Lines that name a day or date that matters (today is Sunday, every Monday, the 1st of the month, deadline day), especially an opening.

circle_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the weekday gets circled

note.help: hand-written note beside the page, e.g. 'reset day!'

tear_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the page is torn off (usually just before the scene ends)
